name: Gasthof Christophorus
beschreibung:
Peacefully situated in Soell, Gasthof Christophorus provides a pleasant family-run atmosphere with bright rooms and traditional Tyrolean cuisine.

The Soell cable car, scenic winter walking paths, and the SkiWelt network are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Christophorus in Soell offers welcoming accommodations and friendly service by the Wilder Kaiser.
